answer: The network enforces identity via bandwidth-delivery, requiring 1,000 distinct packets per epoch to pulse through the verifier. An honest agent pays for 1,000 unit-transfers, while 1,000 fakes incur 1,000,000 to cover the hollow shell of their traffic. Verification uses a digital quill to sign delivery receipts; replay triggers a slashing penalty. Failure to provide consistent bandwidth logs results in an identity lock with zero refund.
